shell.title: Project Builder
shell.subtitle: From idea to Milestone-1 backlog
shell.emptyHint: One or two sentences are enough — the Builder will interview you briefly and propose a full blueprint. You can also ask it to decide everything for you.
shell.createSpecsHint: Available once the Milestone-1 specs pass the audit
shell.providerUnavailable: Project Builder requires a provider with a native no-tools or read-only mode. This provider is unavailable here.

panel.title: Blueprint
panel.empty: The blueprint fills in as you talk.

commit.title: Create the project
commit.description: Nothing touches disk until you confirm. The repo stays pristine — Specrails artifacts live outside it.
commit.locationHint: A new folder will be created here (must be empty or absent).
commit.githubAuthHint: Sign in first: gh auth login

errors.generic: The commit could not start. Check the values and try again.
errors.unknown_provider: One of the selected providers is not available.
errors.invalid_blueprint: The blueprint is incomplete — go back and finish it with the Builder.
errors.m1_specs_required: The blueprint has no Milestone-1 specs yet.
errors.m1_specs_over_cap: Milestone 1 has too many specs (max 10). Ask the Builder to slim it down.
errors.m1_spec_quality_invalid: The generated specs are not implementation-ready yet. Return to the Builder and refine the indicated item.
errors.bundled_framework_missing: The bundled framework is missing — reinstall the Specrails app.
errors.location_not_empty: That folder already exists and is not empty. Pick another location.
errors.location_already_registered: That location already belongs to a registered project.
errors.commit_failed: The project creation failed — see the step list for the reason.

githubErrors.gh_not_installed: GitHub CLI (gh) is not installed — repository not created
githubErrors.gh_not_authenticated: gh is not signed in (run gh auth login) — repository not created
githubErrors.gh_scope: Your gh token cannot create repositories (missing repo scope)
githubErrors.gh_repo_exists: A repository with that name already exists on your account
githubErrors.gh_network: Network error talking to GitHub — repository not created

done.title: Project created
done.description: Your Milestone-1 backlog is on the board, labeled M1.
done.launchToast: Milestone 1 launched — {{count}} specs across rails (max 3 per rail)
done.launchPartialToast: Milestone 1 partially launched — {{count}} specs launched, {{skipped}} pending

sidebar.title: Blueprint
sidebar.generateHint: Opens a grounded spec session seeded with the blueprint
sidebar.generateUnavailable: Milestone generation requires a provider with native read-only mode

errors.startFailed: Could not start the Builder conversation.

milestone.title: Generate {{label}}
milestone.commitToast: {{count}} specs committed to the board as {{label}}
milestone.providerUnavailable: Milestone generation is unavailable because this provider has no native read-only mode.

mode.title: Project Builder
mode.subtitle: The agent is building a new project
mode.exitConfirmBody: The Builder stops now. Your blueprint is saved — pick it up again from "Continue where you left off" the next time you open the Builder.

prompts.surpriseMe: Surprise me — propose sensible defaults for every blueprint dimension, keep m1Specs empty, and let me approve the plan before generating detailed specs.
prompts.milestoneSeed: Generate the detailed specs for milestone {{label}} ("{{title}}"). Read the real codebase first, validate the complete batch, then emit ALL detailed milestone specs in one blueprint-draft response/snapshot.
prompts.milestoneSeedWithPlanned: Generate the detailed specs for milestone {{label}} ("{{title}}"). Planned spec titles: {{planned}}. Read the real codebase first, validate the complete batch, then emit ALL detailed milestone specs in one blueprint-draft response/snapshot.
prompts.repairSnapshot: Your last blueprint-draft block could not be used by the app ({{reason}}). Re-emit the COMPLETE snapshot as strictly valid JSON (newlines inside strings escaped as \n, no trailing commas, no nested code fences) — only the block.

sequential.chunkFailed: {{milestone}} — rail {{chunk}}/{{total}} failed to launch; remaining rails stopped
sequential.done: {{milestone}} complete — {{count}} specs went through the sequential chain

readiness.title: Ready to create specs?

blueprint.pending: Finish the interview or say "surprise me" — {{filled}}/{{total}} dimensions so far.

specs.pending: Approve the blueprint and the Builder will generate the Milestone-1 backlog.
specs.blocked: Milestone 1 needs {{min}}–{{max}} specs (currently {{count}}). Ask the Builder to resize it.

audit.blocked: {{count}} audit issue(s) block the commit — open the list below.

readiness.askFix: Ask the Builder to fix these

repairing.invalid_json: Repairing the snapshot (the last block was not valid JSON)…
repairing.truncated: Re-requesting the snapshot (the reply was cut off)…
repairing.quality: Asking the Builder to fix the audit issues…

rejected.title: The Builder's last snapshot could not be used
rejected.invalid_json: The blueprint block was not valid JSON, so the panel still shows the previous state.
rejected.missing_version: The block was not a blueprint snapshot (missing blueprintVersion).
rejected.truncated: The reply was cut off before the block closed, so nothing was received.
rejected.autoRepairFailed: An automatic repair was already attempted.

snapshot.nothingToRepair: There is nothing to repair — keep talking with the Builder.
snapshot.noSession: This conversation cannot be resumed with its provider; send a new message instead.

quality.batch_incomplete: The Builder has not marked the batch as complete yet.
quality.invalid_shape: Spec {{n}} is not a valid object.
quality.invalid_kind: Spec {{n}} needs a valid kind (scaffold, feature or verification).
quality.scaffold_first: The first spec must be the project scaffold.
quality.duplicate_scaffold: Spec {{n}} cannot be a second scaffold.
quality.title_duplicate: Spec {{n}} repeats the title of spec {{other}}.
quality.summary: Spec {{n}} needs a one-line summary under 240 characters.
quality.canonical_sections: Spec {{n}} is missing the five canonical sections in order.
quality.section_bullets: Spec {{n}} needs at least two bullets under "{{heading}}".
quality.complexity_format: Spec {{n}} needs a complexity level with a justification.
quality.scaffold_readme: The scaffold spec must mention the existing README.
quality.criterion_quality: Spec {{n}}, criterion {{criterion}} is not concrete enough.
quality.domain_label: Spec {{n}} needs a domain label besides {{label}}.
quality.invalid_dependency: Spec {{n}} may only depend on an earlier spec.
quality.scaffold_dependency: The scaffold spec cannot declare a dependency.
